answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31324 Country: AU Title: 6 months back my friend has seen a 8-7 years old boy (who is rootless poor living on street type). Question: Please if you can tell me the meaning of 2 dreams. My friend has seen those and asked for meaning. 1. 6 months back my friend has seen a 8-7 years old boy (who is rootless poor living on street type). Then my friend somehow got angry on that boy and started to chase him. The boy ran on a wall and urinate on my friend and then my friend used some bad words to the boy and wake up from dream. {{meanwhile my friend's wife got pregnant and now she is 3 months with her pregnancy.}} 2. 2 weeks back my friend has shift his home. and then 2 days before he was sleeping around afternoon. He saw then in a dream that -- there is a lady with her 1-2 years old child started to live with him and his wife as a flatmate (shareing one room in his new home). then my friend took that lady's child in his lap and the child urinate in my friends lap. As my friends wife is pregnant he is very tensed for those 2 dreams, so Please reply ASAP for the meaning and any necessary action needed to take. Answer ID: 31324 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 497/416/B=1432) Your friend might be earning any unlawful income or he might be involved in any haram job. If it is so, he should give it up. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
